name: NFS THE RUN OST WAV PACK
teaser: Compilation of NFS THE RUN OST in their original format (WAV) so you have the highest quality music.
description_html:
All of the music here is in WAV format. There is No Race Music (Should I make a semi-dynamic music pack now that there is a proper working raid music loader?), only music that is used in either Garages, Hideouts, or Main Menu(s). I only put the ones that I have and like. I also added some of the Custom Mixes I made using the OST. ALL MUSIC WAS EXTRACTED FROM GAME FILES BY ME OR RIPPED FROM “Blu-Ray” ALBUM (You probably won’t find any of this stuff on the internet because no one bothered to upload their gamerip, and I suffered a lot trying to search for a gamerip that no one had interesting in publishing and they never did xd, only scripts were available for the game engines so I had to do the ripping myself back when I had zero knowledge in python). I also added NFS Rivals Garage Theme since I also extracted the game files from that game.

I wanted to share my set of custom music, someone may like it… maybe…
